question: ABCD is a quadrilateral with ∠A = 3(x + 2)°, ∠B = 2(2x − 7)°, ∠C = 69° and ∠D = ∠C − 8°. What is the value of ∠B?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Sum of interior angles in a quadrilateral is 360°.

∠A + ∠B = 360° − (∠C + ∠D) = 360° − (69° + 61°) = 230°

3(x + 2) + 2(2x − 7) = 230 ⇒ 7x − 8 = 230

7x = 238 ⇒ x = 34

∠B = 2(2 × 34 − 7) = 122°

**∴ The correct answer is 122°.**
